metaDescription: Westcott Concrete won our 2026 Concrete Finishing & Pouring award for Windsor, Ontario. Driveways, patios and stamped work in Windsor-Essex.
summary: Westcott Concrete pours and finishes driveways, patios, sidewalks and garage floors for residential and commercial clients across Windsor and Essex County. The company also builds decorative stamped concrete and retaining walls.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: Westcott Concrete offers concrete driveways, patios, sidewalks, garage floors, stamped concrete and retaining walls. Adding retaining walls to a concrete finishing company's service list is useful for homeowners doing a broader hardscape project involving grade changes alongside a new driveway or patio.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: The company serves both residential and commercial clients across Windsor and Essex County, with named coverage in Tecumseh, LaSalle and Belle River. As with any concrete pouring project, ask about site prep, forming and curing timelines specific to your job before finalizing a schedule. Concrete work in this region also has to account for freeze-thaw cycles over an Ontario winter, so ask how the company's forming and curing process is adapted for durability rather than just appearance on day one.

editorial.heading: What to expect
editorial.text: No customer reviews are published for this listing yet, so ask the company directly for recent local references, particularly for a project similar in scope, such as a driveway pour or stamped patio. Ask to see photos of completed stamped concrete work in the pattern and colour you are considering.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: The business serves Windsor and Essex County communities including Tecumseh, LaSalle and Belle River. Homeowners outside this named area should confirm coverage before requesting a quote.

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: Westcott Concrete was selected through our independent editorial review for 2026 as the top concrete finishing and pouring contractor serving the Windsor area, based on public services and service area, with no fee for consideration or winning.
